limitations: Other parser operations and runtime maps remain separate resource-accounting work.
The merge collects/sorts a whole lexical list before selecting the earliest duplicate; resource exhaustion may precede syntax reporting on larger inputs.
Duplicate names occupy temporary records until validation ends; compilation accounting remains cumulative without refunds.
Owned syntax, parsing and expression/statement/function execution still have recursive paths.
No depth acceptance or performance claim; local regression checks and mutation smoke are not a security proof or complete web compatibility evidence.
